gecko.visible_surface_material: aluminum can with coated paper/plastic label
gecko.visible_surface_condition: smooth, clean, cylindrical metal and coated paper wrapper
evidence_used: Standard-sized aluminum beverage can visible in image
Cylindrical geometry providing smooth opposing sidewalls
Clean and dry surface condition suitable for mushroom-cap gecko pads
gecko.calculation_summary: Estimated required force based on a nominal ~0.35 kg object weight under standard gravity (approx 3.5 N weight), divided by estimated friction/adhesion coefficient ratio. F_normal = W / (2 * mu_effective). With gecko dry adhesion providing high directional shear resistance, normal force preload is kept low at 1.2 N.
assumptions_and_uncertainty: Object mass is assumed to be roughly 0.35 kg based on standard visual scale of an aluminum can.
Surface is assumed dry and clean.
Visual estimation introduces uncertainty in exact weight and coefficient of adhesion.
gecko.reasoning_trace: The gecko gripper excels on clean, smooth, nonporous cylindrical surfaces like an aluminum can. The smooth sidewalls allow intimate contact of the mushroom-cap gecko pads. A low normal force of 1.2 N is sufficient to seat the compliant fin-ray backing and engage the dry adhesive for safe lifting.

silicone.visible_surface_material: aluminum can with coated paper/plastic label
silicone.visible_surface_condition: smooth, clean, cylindrical metal and coated paper wrapper
evidence_used: Standard-sized aluminum beverage can visible in image
Cylindrical geometry providing smooth opposing sidewalls
Smooth, clean surface allowing high-friction silicone engagement
silicone.calculation_summary: Estimated required force based on a nominal ~0.35 kg object weight (approx 3.5 N weight). F_normal = W / (2 * mu_friction). Assuming a conservative silicone-to-aluminum friction coefficient around 0.7, F_normal = 3.5 / (2 * 0.7) approx 2.5 N.
assumptions_and_uncertainty: Silicone friction coefficient estimated visually without direct tribological testing.
silicone.reasoning_trace: The silicone high-friction pad easily conforms to the cylindrical aluminum can. Because friction relies on normal preload rather than specialized directional dry adhesion, a higher normal force of 2.5 N is required to securely lift the object without slip.

comparison_evidence: Cylindrical aluminum can provides smooth, clean, nonporous sidewalls highly favorable to gecko dry adhesion
Gecko gripper achieves reliable lifting with lower normal force (1.2 N) compared to the high-friction silicone gripper (2.5 N)
recommendation_summary: Both grippers are fully feasible for lifting the smooth aluminum beverage can. The gecko gripper is recommended because its dry-adhesive pads couple exceptionally well with smooth, clean, nonporous cylindrical metal, allowing a lower pre-load normal force (1.2 N) than the friction-dependent silicone pad (2.5 N).
